identity.operation: Dump a value returned by json_loadb through do_dump.
identity.condition: The loaded value reaches the new dump depth limit.
identity.capability: json_loadb and parse_json must admit a value that reaches the do_dump guard.
identity.consequence: Dumping returns failure at the depth limit.

requirement: For a reachable value at the depth limit, dumping must return failure.

assessment.necessity_reason: The old harness calls a dump operation for every value returned by json_loadb. Thus, if the frozen depth condition is feasible, the harness has a route to the new failure behavior; if it is infeasible, that behavior is not required for this target. Parser feasibility cannot be resolved from the supplied evidence.

before.requirement: The frozen requirement to return failure at the new dump depth limit does not apply to the old do_dump contract.
before.reason: The complete old do_dump body has no depth limit guard.

after.requirement: If json_loadb admits a value whose dump traversal reaches JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH, do_dump returns failure at that depth.
after.reason: The guard returns -1 at the limit. The harness passes every successfully loaded value to json_dumps or json_dump_callback, both of which invoke do_dump, so it reaches the guard whenever such a value is admitted. The omitted parser depth rules prevent a definite applicability finding.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array traversal increments the depth passed to do_dump.
The callback dump entry invokes do_dump.
The string dump entry delegates to json_dump_callback.
json_loadb delegates input acceptance to parse_json.
parse_json delegates value construction to parse_value, whose depth rules were not supplied.

assessment.comparison_reason: The added failure guard has no established old harness blocker: the harness already invokes dumping on each accepted value. Whether accepted input can attain the guarded depth is unresolved.
missing_information: Complete before and after bodies of src/load.c::parse_value, src/load.c::parse_array, and src/load.c::parse_object.

evidence.dependency_reason: The entry loads the input and dumps every non-NULL result.

feasible_trigger.reason: The packet does not establish whether parse_value admits a valid input whose dump traversal reaches JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH.

observable_consequence.reason: The guard returns failure at the limit, but no blocked supported behavior is shown: the harness invokes dumping on each accepted value and makes no assertion about the dump result.

evidence.dependency_reason: Both dump paths are invoked after a successful load, and their results are not checked.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: Both existing dump modes reach do_dump for a loaded value. This is an equivalent route to the guard whenever the frozen condition is feasible.

evidence.dependency_reason: Callback dumping invokes do_dump at depth zero.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: do_dump returns failure when traversal reaches JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH.
coverage_witness.required_setup: A valid json_loadb result with sufficient nesting; parser acceptance at that depth is unproven.
